weapon.d: Grants Spd+3. If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 to unit during combat and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Spd (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat. Grants Atk/Spd+4 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.

assist.d: Unit and target ally swap spaces.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP ≤ 80%, grants Atk/Spd+3 during combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≤ 80%, grants Atk/Spd+5 during combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≤ 80%, grants Atk/Spd+7 during combat.

c.d: Grants Atk+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk+2 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.
Grants Atk+3 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.

builds.name: Support of Sothis
builds.desc: This build is a purely support/defensive build, unusual for Seteth, and very expensive too. However, a discount version of this build is easier to make and is still viable. Owing to Pavise, Deflect Melee and Guard Bearing in combination, he can take almost no damage from units such as Jill.

Owing to Pavise, Deflect Melee and Guard Bearing in combination, he can take almost no damage from units such as Jill. The weapon and C skills can be changed depending on if you want Seteth to support other units, or be a defensive tank.
